name: CCS Combo 1
description: Combined AC/DC charging interface: configuration EE of IEC 62196-3, the combo coupler of SAE J1772. The vehicle inlet combines a Type 1 AC section with two DC contacts below it; the DC vehicle connector keeps only PE, CP, CS and the two DC contacts.

electricalProfiles.name: DC
conditions: Maximum rating of configuration EE in IEC 62196-3:2022 (edition 2.0), tables 302 and 303.
IEC 62196-3:2026 (edition 3.0) announces increased ratings for all configurations; they are not recorded here yet.
Products are rated individually and may be lower; for example one inlet datasheet gives 200 A / 1000 V DC.
Used only with DC EV supply equipment of System C (IEC 61851-23 Annex CC).
CP and CS are signal contacts rated 30 V, 2 A.

electricalProfiles.name: AC single-phase (Type 1 section)
conditions: AC ratings follow IEC 62196-2 Type 1 (IEC 62196-3:2022, table 302: 250 V, 32 A on L1 and L2/N).
The second power contact is L2 or N depending on the supply; it is not mapped to a single function here.
IEC 62196-2:2025 allows Type 1 vehicle connectors up to 80 A in the US, KR and JP; see the iec-62196-type-1 family.

notes: DC ratings come from the 2022 edition; the increased ratings of IEC 62196-3:2026 are not reviewed yet.
The SAE J1772 combo coupler text was not reviewed, only the abstract of SAE J1772_202401.

The DC vehicle connector contact set follows IEC 62196-3:2022 table 302 (AC contacts only on the inlet); its contact gender is inferred from mating with the male inlet, and its face is not drawn because no reviewed source depicts it.
Liquid-cooled ratings (IEC 62196-3:2026 Annex AA, formerly IEC TS 62196-3-1) are not modelled yet.
